name: ht-personal-income-tax-new-code
description: Haiti personal income tax reference for the replacement Code commencing on 1 October 2026. Provides the enacted annual progressive bands, worked marginal-rate examples, annual return deadline, deduction evidence and credit treatment. Distinguishes the commencement period from returns for income earned before the Code took effect. Explains the prohibition on deducting the same expense twice and the restriction of category losses to income of the same category. Residency, treaty relief, detailed income categories, implementation decisions and independent professional verification remain outside this initial source-cited draft.
